text:
liz: quick sync 2: we need to scope compliance rollout for next quarter. customers keep asking for clearer retention tiers + a BYO onboarding path.

owen: agree. propose retention tiers: short(30d), standard(90d), extended(1y), archival(7y). map them to product SKUs?

maria: from privacy/legal: tiers must have default redaction for PII unless customer opts into full capture with legal sign-off. also need export proof for legal holds.

liz: good. for BYO (KMS) onboarding, customers want staged rollout: 1) key registration + test encrypt/decrypt, 2) pilot with test tenant, 3) live migration with snapshot and verification. we should require atomic migration or explicit rollback.

security-bot: Reminder: include CMEK rotation policy and HSM-backed escrow for long-lived keys per policy CMP-2.

owen: acceptance criteria idea: each retention tier needs UI to set per-tenant retention, automated purge process, retention audit log, and one-click evidence export. can we make export incremental?

maria: legal wants export tamper-proof: exports must include signed manifest (sha256) and retention policy id. also add `legal_hold_id` field.

liz: propose launch plan: Phase A (GA): standard tier + 30d short + export v1. Phase B (90d+1y tiers) + BYO pilot. Phase C (archival + HSM escrow) for regulated customers. timeline: Phase A in 6 weeks, B in 12 weeks, C in 20 weeks.

owen: risk note: rolling purge and retention SLOs could affect latency if we do synchronous deletes. recommend async background purge with DAemons and backpressure.

sam: ops will size background job workers and estimate cost impact. will share numbers by Tues.

liz: can we get engineering owners? owen + sam on retention engine. maria owns export/legal fields. security-bot assigned to security team for KMS runbook.

owen: follow-ups: I6ll draft API contract with sample ndjson, including fields: `ts, tenant_id, event_type, actor, action, model, tokens_in, tokens_out, auth_method, kms_key`, and `redaction_level`. Also adding `legal_hold_id` optional.

maria: good start. add `data_classification` tag (sensitive, regulated, public) and `export_signature` meta.

liz: last call: does CS need messaging templates for tiers? sam: yes, CS wants migration FAQ and playbook.

security-bot: Created ticket SEC-9021 KMS-canary and PROD-4602 retention-purge-runbook

liz: ok landing: owen to post API draft by EOD, sam to post worker sizing Tues, maria to draft export manifest schema Thu. we'll reconvene Fri morning. :rocket:
